## PRB1.3. Safety

-   In 2025, LGS achieved the planned maturity levels set out in its performance plan for all five components of the EoSM.

-   Latvia has not included any airports in their RP4 performance plans, thus not reporting on runway incursions during the reference period.

-   The rate of separation minima infringements (SMIs) at State level was 3.15, and at ANSP level 1.57. Both indicators were below the Union-wide average. When comparing to 2024, rate of SMIs has increased at State level and decreased at ANSP level.
